    DATE_TRUNC('month', month_start) AS metric_time__month
    , DATE_TRUNC('quarter', month_start) AS metric_time__quarter
    , department AS workforce__department

    , tenure_band AS workforce__tenure_band
    , is_termination AS __terminations
    , is_active_eom AS __employee_months

  SELECT
    metric_time__quarter
    , CAST(employee_months AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(snapshot_months, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_headcount
  FROM (
    SELECT
      metric_time__quarter
      , SUM(employee_months) AS employee_months
      , COUNT(DISTINCT snapshot_months) AS snapshot_months

      SELECT
        metric_time__month

        , workforce__job_level
        , workforce__employment_type

      (list_contains($f_department, '__all__') OR list_contains($f_department, workforce__department))

      (list_contains($f_location, '__all__') OR list_contains($f_location, workforce__location))
